answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the ivory of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the glacier re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the willow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
